project_summary: Online medical clinic booking interface allowing patients to schedule 30-minute consultations with available doctors.

features.name: Doctor Calendar View
features.description: Weekly calendar displaying available 30-minute appointment slots for doctors.

features.name: Appointment Booking Form
features.description: Patient inputs personal details and confirms selection of available appointment slot.

features.name: Confidential Medical Notes
features.description: Secure text area allowing patient to provide consultation notes prior to visit.

user_stories.goal: view doctor availability on a weekly calendar
user_stories.benefit: select a time slot that matches my schedule
confirm my appointment with the doctor
provide context to the physician before the consultation

acceptance_criteria.given: A patient is viewing the clinic booking page
acceptance_criteria.when: A doctor is selected from the dropdown
acceptance_criteria.then: Available 30-minute slots are rendered on the weekly calendar

acceptance_criteria.given: A patient has selected an open slot
acceptance_criteria.when: They submit valid contact details and click confirm
acceptance_criteria.then: The appointment is reserved and an appointment reference number is displayed

acceptance_criteria.given: A patient is confirming a booking
acceptance_criteria.then: The notes are stored with restricted access visible only to the assigned doctor

frontend: Booking confirmation modal with note textarea
data: appointments table (id, slot_id, patient_name, notes, status)
risks: Double booking of the same slot during concurrent patient submissions
Data privacy compliance for stored medical notes

test_cases.title: Successfully book an open appointment slot
test_cases.expected_result: System returns 200 OK, marks slot as booked, and returns confirmation code

test_cases.title: Prevent booking an already reserved slot
steps: Select a slot that was already booked by another user
test_cases.expected_result: System returns 409 Conflict with error message 'Slot is no longer available'

test_cases.title: Booking request during daylight saving time changeover
steps: Request booking during UTC timezone shift boundary
test_cases.expected_result: System stores appointment in unambiguous UTC ISO format without corrupting time

developer_prompt: You are implementing the Smart Clinic Portal scheduling module. Constraints: Use FastAPI and SQLite with transactional row-level isolation on availability_slots to prevent double booking. Expose GET availability and POST booking endpoints conforming strictly to the defined schema. Write comprehensive unit tests.
assumptions: Appointments are fixed at 30 minutes duration.
System stores all timestamps in UTC.
open_questions: What is the clinic cancellation policy timeframe?
Do patients require SMS or email confirmation notifications?
